_meta.status: METACOD-RF — Research Framework, not clinical guidance
_meta.group: Антидиабетические — Insulins (9 by action profile) + Amylin analog (pramlintide). Antidiabetic group COMPLETE.
_meta.author: Mark Litvak (с AI-assistance)

insulin_intro: Инсулин — самый старый, изученный, универсальный антидиабетический (с 1922, Banting & Best).
Классы по времени действия: ultra-rapid, rapid (analog), short (regular), intermediate (NPH), long-acting, ultra-long.

action_profiles.ultra_rapid: onset 5-10 min / peak 30-60 min / duration 3-4h (aspart faster, lispro-aabc)
action_profiles.rapid_analog: onset 15 min / peak 1-2h / duration 3-5h (aspart, lispro, glulisine)
action_profiles.long_acting: onset 2-4h / minimal peak / duration 20-24h (glargine U100, detemir)
action_profiles.ultra_long: onset 0.5-1.5h / minimal peak / duration 36-42h (glargine U300, degludec)

regimen_strategies: Basal-only (once-daily long-acting; добавляется когда orals не достигают цели)
Basal + GLP-1 — современный preferred (basal до 0.5 U/kg + GLP-1 для prandial)
Basal-bolus (long-acting + rapid с каждым meal; closest к physiological; required в T1DM)
energetic_principle: Все инсулины — anabolic force (directly adds anabolic force from outside).

Strongly anabolic → pushes M-A; predictable weight gain 2-4 kg/год; highest hypoglycemia risk; damp accumulation; yang surge с каждой injection (но not necessarily yang exhaustion — инсулин replaces, не forces native pancreas).
when_insulin_in_t2dm: Severe hyperglycemia (HbA1c >10%); symptomatic ketosis; pregnancy T2DM/GDM не controlled lifestyle/metformin; renal impairment где SGLT2/GLP-1 limited и orals недостаточны; hospitalized acute illness; T1DM (absolute).
mark_canonical_elderly: Инсулин в frail elderly требует HbA1c target 7.5-8.5%, не <7%. Tight control в frail elderly = hypoglycemia disasters.
mandatory_safety_recommendations: HbA1c target individualized to age, frailty, life expectancy
Patient + caregiver education on hypoglycemia recognition
CGM strongly recommended в elderly / hypoglycemia-prone
Glucagon emergency kit prescribed для severe hypoglycemia
